description: Executes verified distributed matrix multiplication C = A x B across decentralized GPU workers with dynamic Freivalds verification and L402 settlement. Accepts file paths (.npy, .npz, .safetensors) or inline 2D JSON arrays.

matrix_a.description: File path (.npy/.npz/.safetensors) or inline 2D array for matrix A (M x K).

matrix_b.description: File path (.npy/.npz/.safetensors) or inline 2D array for matrix B (K x N).

output_path.description: Optional output file path (.npy, .npz, or .safetensors) to write C.

tensor_key_a.description: Optional tensor key when loading matrix_a from .safetensors or .npz.

tensor_key_b.description: Optional tensor key when loading matrix_b from .safetensors or .npz.

name: execute_distributed_matmul
